headline: Frenzied Assault
title: Frenzied Assault | Saws and Whirlbite Trick | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Saws and Whirlbite share the Surging Wave trait. Their damaging skills build Water Debuff, and moving far enough puts them into Frenzied Assault. In that state Wavebreaker Shark Rush becomes a piercing dash with bonus damage. High-Speed Cut cuts the distance you need to trigger it in half. Whirlbite's ultimate Hunter's Feast starts Frenzied Assault straight away. Keep swimming and spinning. Will you try this Water combo? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Frenzied Assault explained: how Saws and Whirlbite build Water Debuff, enter Frenzied Assault by moving, and turn Wavebreaker Shark Rush into a piercing dash. High-Speed Cut halves the distance needed. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
joke: Frenzied Assault is just a Water Aniimo refusing to stand still.
